data.name: CRB_001
data.value: The heart of the ruins...[pause=15] It's still beating.

data.name: CRB_002
data.value: Look at those golden veins...[pause=15] They're pulsing.

data.name: CRB_003
data.value: The Fallen Titan...[pause=30] It has waited for millennia.

data.name: CRB_004
data.value: You...[pause=10] You followed us all the way here?

data.name: CRB_005
data.value: I am wherever the life of the Hearts weakens.

data.name: CRB_006
data.value: And here...[pause=20] the Heart barely beats at all.

data.name: CRB_007
data.value: REGIGIGAS![pause=10] The Titan of the Ruins!

data.name: CRB_008
data.value: I protect what remains of the Heart.[pause=20] If you defeat me,[pause=10] the Heart is yours.

data.name: CRB_009
data.value: If you fail...[pause=30] this Heart will fade forever.

data.name: CRB_010
data.value: Then we can't lose.[pause=15] {0}, let's go!

data.name: CRB_011
data.value: This time, we take it down!

data.name: CRB_012
data.value: We defeated the Titan!

data.name: CRB_013
data.value: Look...[pause=15] the stone, beneath our feet.[pause=10] It still pulses.[pause=15] But weaker now.[pause=0] As if catching its breath.

data.name: CRB_014
data.value: (That voice...[pause=20] it guided us here on purpose.)

data.name: CRB_015
data.value: We need to talk to Phileas.[pause=25] He knows more than he's letting on.

data.name: CRB_016
data.value: The Titan shows no mercy...

data.name: CRB_017
data.value: But this Heart awaits you.[pause=30] Return when you are ready.

data.name: CRB_018
data.value: Urgh...[pause=10] The Titan...[pause=15] it's unstoppable...

data.name: CRB_019
data.value: Regigigas rises to its full height.[pause=20] The golden veins pulse slowly.

data.name: CRB_020
data.value: You are not the first to challenge the Titan.[pause=30] Nor the last to fall.

data.name: CRB_021
data.value: The colossus returns to its millennial slumber.[pause=20] The ruins fall silent once more.

data.name: CRB_022
data.value: Regigigas staggers.[pause=15] Its golden veins flicker,[pause=5] then fade.[pause=20] It falls to its knees.

data.name: CRB_023
data.value: The Titan looks at you.[pause=30] No anger.[pause=15] Just... surprise.

data.name: CRB_024
data.value: You have done what no living being has accomplished in millennia.[pause=30] The Titan bows before you.

data.name: CRB_025
data.value: It freezes into a stone statue,[pause=15] returning to the state you found it in.[pause=20] But this time,[pause=10] the Heart beats freely.

data.name: CRB_026
data.value: We defeated the Titan of the Ruins...[pause=15] I can't believe it.

data.name: CRB_027
data.value: The Titan falls.[pause=30] The Anima Heart is saved.[pause=25] You have changed this region's destiny.

data.name: CRB_028
data.value: The air hums. Five shapes drift out of the walls, one by one.

data.name: CRB_029
data.value: Unown ![pause=15] They're... arranging themselves.

data.name: CRB_030
data.value: They hold their places. Five letters, in order, above the sealed door.

data.name: CRB_031
data.value: R... E... G... I... S.[pause=25] It spells something.

data.name: CRB_032
data.value: The builders left the answer written on the door they locked.[pause=25] They wanted it opened.

data.name: CRB_033
data.value: Then say it. Out loud.

data.name: CRB_034
data.value: The five Unown flare at once, and the door grinds open.

data.name: CRB_035
data.value: Three alcoves. Three shapes that have not moved in centuries.

data.name: CRB_036
data.value: The stone one wakes first. Gravel pours off its shoulders.

data.name: CRB_037
data.value: The ice one next. The whole chamber drops several degrees.

data.name: CRB_038
data.value: And the iron one last. It does not wake — it was never asleep.

data.name: CRB_039
data.value: Three of them ![pause=15] The seal wasn't holding one guardian.[pause=20] It was holding a watch.

data.name: CRB_040
data.value: They will test you before the one behind them stirs.[pause=25] That is the order. It has always been the order.

data.name: CRB_041
data.value: Stone, ice and iron...[pause=20] and something bigger breathing behind them.

data.name: CRB_042
data.value: The three step back into their alcoves without a sound.[pause=20] The watch resumes.

data.name: CRB_043
data.value: You were measured.[pause=25] You were found wanting.[pause=20] Come back when the measure changes.

data.name: CRB_044
data.value: The Unown are gone from the walls.[pause=20] The door is shut again.

data.name: CRB_R01
data.value: The three alcoves are empty.[pause=20] The seals are still broken, exactly as we left them.

data.name: CRB_R02
data.value: (No breathing under the stone.[pause=15] For the first time, these ruins are only ruins.)

data.name: CRB_R03
data.value: The golden veins have gone grey.[pause=20] Whatever was flowing through them stopped a long time ago.

data.name: CRB_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.

data.name: CRB_045
data.value: ...Halt.

data.name: CRB_046
data.value: Designation: sentinel.[pause=25] Post: this chamber.[pause=20] Duration: unknown.

data.name: CRB_047
data.value: I was told to hold until relieved.[pause=30] No one came.

data.name: CRB_048
data.value: Small ones.[pause=25] Are you the relief?

data.name: CRB_049
data.value: No.[pause=30] The relief does not arrive armed.

data.name: CRB_050
data.value: Then the order stands.[pause=25] Nothing leaves this chamber.

data.name: CRB_051
data.value: ...Order.[pause=30] Broken.

data.name: CRB_052
data.value: Sentinel.[pause=25] Relieved.

data.name: CRB_053
data.value: I do not remember who gave the order.[pause=30] I remember obeying it.

data.name: CRB_054
data.value: That is all that is left of me.[pause=25] The obeying.

data.name: CRB_055
data.value: Take it.[pause=30] But answer me one thing, small ones.

data.name: CRB_056
data.value: If something must be kept away from the world...[pause=25] why was I posted FACING it?

data.name: CRB_057
data.value: A guard faces what he keeps out.[pause=35] I have faced what sleeps beneath the stone for a thousand years.

data.name: CRB_058
data.value: Go.[pause=25] Before I remember the rest of the order.

data.name: CRB_059
data.value: Facing it...[pause=25] Then this was never a treasure chamber.

data.name: CRB_060
data.value: The colossus sits back down in the dust,[pause=20] turned toward what he guarded.[pause=25] As he always has been.
